about: Every line of Larkspur's phone calls. scripts/record-voice.mjs speaks each one with ElevenLabs text-to-speech (once, by hand) into public/data/voice/<id>.mp3 and data/voice/envelopes.json. A line is one clip; its parts are spoken one after another with `pause` ms of silence after each. What speech-to-text wrote for each caller turn is recorded in transcripts.json; `gain` makes a part quieter; `noise` mixes a steady line hum into the whole clip.

ravi.name: Ravi
ravi.about: Ravi runs a building site for Marlow Builders.

assistant.name: Larkspur’s assistant
assistant.about: The voice of Larkspur’s phone line.

parts.text: Hi, could you tell me where order ten forty-three is?
Order ten forty-three, your three rolls of labels, is being packed now.
It should leave the warehouse tomorrow.
I need to change the delivery address on my order.
It's order ten fifty-one.
Can it go to our new site on Mill Road?
Of course. Which order is it?
Order ten fifty-one, the two shelving bays. What's the new address?
Order ten fifty-one has already left us. I've asked the carrier to take it to Mill Road instead.
Hi, it’s Ravi on site, has the scanner turned up yet?
It's order ten forty-seven.
Hi Ravi. How can I help?
Sorry, which order is the scanner on?
Order ten forty-seven, the Kestrel scanner, was delivered on the sixteenth.
Can we book a delivery slot for the label printer?
I have three slots this week.
Tuesday morning,
Wednesday afternoon,
or Friday, first thing.
Sorry, we're closed on Tuesdays.
No problem. I also have Wednesday afternoon, or Friday, first thing.
No problem. Then Wednesday afternoon, or I also have Friday, first thing.
Shall I book Tuesday morning for you, then?
Hi, can you check on order twenty-six fifteen?
Order twenty-six fifty was delivered on Monday.
Just to check: that's order two, six, five, zero?
No. Two, six, one, five.
Thanks. Order twenty-six fifteen, your dock door sensors, ships on Thursday.
